features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker, document appears in list
features.evidence: 2026-11-15: npm run check clean; npm run build clean. Launched Electron 33 with an isolated --user-data-dir and drove the real <input type=file> over CDP (DOM.setFileInputFiles): .pdf -> inline 'Unsupported file type' error, 10.5 MB .txt -> inline 'too large' error, nothing stored; design-notes.md and meeting-summary.txt imported -> appear in sidebar, selected, status bar shows Documents: N; re-importing design-notes.md creates a 3rd separate doc. On disk: documents-meta.json has 3 entries, content/<id>.txt and documents/<id>-<filename> byte-identical to source. Direct IPC import of a missing path rejects with 'File not found'.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content via getContent IPC, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: 2026-11-15 (session 2): npm run check and npm run build clean. Launched Electron 33 with an isolated --user-data-dir and drove the UI over CDP: imported alpha.md and beta.txt through the real file input; after import beta's text renders in [data-testid=document-content]; selecting alpha in the sidebar shows content byte-identical to the source file; Hide Content removes the viewer and View Content restores it; beta indexed -> 'Show Chunks (4)'; Delete shows an inline confirmation, Cancel keeps the doc, Confirm Delete removes it from list and sidebar. On disk after delete: documents/<beta-id>-beta.txt, content/<beta-id>.txt, chunks/<beta-id>.json and the beta entry in index-meta.json are all gone, alpha's files untouched. getContent('../../documents-meta') -> null and delete('../x') -> false (non-UUID ids rejected).

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage in userData directory
features.evidence: 2026-11-15 (session 2): npm run check and build clean. App.tsx calls refreshDocuments() on mount. Quit the Electron process from the document-detail run and launched a new one with the same --user-data-dir: without any click, the sidebar shows 'Documents (1)' with alpha and the status bar shows 'Index: ready | Documents: 1'. Selecting alpha shows its full content, identical to the source file.
